title: The ending epilogue states 'You backed Tamsin on the barrow doors, sealed for the living's sake' — but I explicitly chose 'leave the doors open to the sky' for the Vale's barrow (confirmed by the game itself: 'You leave the doors open to the sky... Quest done: The Barrow Doors'). The epilogue appears to conflate that separate, already-resolved choice with an unrelated, vaguely-worded companion-dialogue line ('back her — a door that holds') said to Tamsin at Cinderhall about the Hundred Gallery mine, and mislabels it as the barrow.
where: The Hollow Throne (ending epilogue) / Ironbound Chapterhouse (Tamsin dialogue, 'back her — a door that holds')
